rules.0: Both players get the same random exercise — technique, fretboard theory or an ear quiz.
rules.1: Playing drills need the mic on: only mic-scored runs count. Quizzes give +100 for a right answer and −100 for a wrong one.
rules.2: 48 hours, as many runs as you like. Your best run is your score.
rules.3: Done before the time is up? Press Ready to lock in your best — no more runs after that. When both of you are ready, the duel ends right away.
rules.4: You see how many attempts your opponent made — never their name or score until it ends.
rules.5: Beat a stronger player and you gain more ELO. Didn't play at all? That's a loss.
